paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: (left) and (right) on GSM8K with different settings: decoding length L, sampling steps S, refresh intervals and the window size.
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the trade-off between decoding speed (in Tokens/s on the x-axis, linear scale from 20 to 160) and model performance (Accuracy % on the y-axis, linear scale from 65 to 85) for diffusion language models under varying cache configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Speed (Tokens/s)” and spans from 20 to 160 with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Performance (Accuracy %)” and spans from 65 to 85 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. Five distinct lines represent different combinations of decoding length (L) and sampling steps (S): a blue line with square markers for L=512, S=512; a blue dashed line with square markers for L=512, S=256; a blue dash-dotted line with square markers for L=512, S=128; a red line with cross markers for L=128, S=64; and a red dash-dotted line with cross markers for L=128, S=32. Additionally, a black dotted line labeled “LLaDA Pareto Front” and a black dashed line labeled “Cache Pareto Front” are plotted. The blue line (L=512, S=512) starts at approximately 83% accuracy at 20 Tokens/s and decreases to about 78% at 160 Tokens/s. The blue dashed line (L=512, S=256) begins at approximately 82% at 20 Tokens/s and declines to around 75% at 160 Tokens/s. The blue dash-dotted line (L=512, S=128) starts at approximately 80% at 20 Tokens/s and decreases to about 73% at 160 Tokens/s. The red line (L=128, S=64) begins at approximately 72% at 20 Tokens/s and remains relatively flat, dropping slightly to about 70% at 160 Tokens/s. The red dash-dotted line (L=128, S=32) starts at approximately 70% at 20 Tokens/s and remains nearly constant at about 68% at 160 Tokens/s. The black dotted “LLaDA Pareto Front” line begins at approximately 82% at 20 Tokens/s and decreases to about 65% at 160 Tokens/s. The black dashed “Cache Pareto Front” line starts at approximately 83% at 20 Tokens/s and decreases to about 64% at 160 Tokens/s. A legend indicates that the blue and red lines correspond to different refresh intervals (w/o Cache, Refresh=2, Refresh=4, Refresh=8, Refresh=16), but these are not visually represented as separate lines in the plot.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the trade-off between decoding speed (in Tokens/s on the x-axis, using a linear scale ranging from 20 to 160) and model performance (Accuracy % on the y-axis, using a linear scale ranging from 65 to 85) for different configurations of a cache system. The x-axis is labeled "Speed (Tokens/s)" and the y-axis is labeled "Performance (Accuracy %)". The plot contains multiple lines representing different cache configurations: a blue line with square markers (L=512, S=512), a blue line with circle markers (L=512, S=256), a blue line with triangle markers (L=512, S=128), a red line with square markers (L=128, S=64), and a red line with circle markers (L=128, S=32). Additionally, there is a dotted black line labeled "LLaDA Pareto Front" and a dashed black line labeled "Cache Pareto Front". The plot also includes a legend indicating different "Refresh" intervals (w/o Cache, Refresh=2, Refresh=4, Refresh=8, Refresh=16), each represented by a distinct marker style. For the L=512, S=512 configuration, performance starts at approximately 83% at 20 Tokens/s and declines to about 74% at 160 Tokens/s. For the L=128, S=64 configuration, performance starts at approximately 72% at 60 Tokens/s and declines to about 68% at 160 Tokens/s. The Cache Pareto Front line begins at approximately 83% at 20 Tokens/s and declines to about 65% at 160 Tokens/s. The LLaDA Pareto Front line begins at approximately 83% at 20 Tokens/s and declines to about 65% at 160 Tokens/s.
